cohort: The study cohort consisted of 352 placentas diagnosed with chronic villitis of unknown etiology (VUE) and 657 control placentas without this diagnosis, matched 2:1, from deliveries ≥ 20 weeks between 2010 and 2018.
finding: Gestational diabetes and gestational hypertension were associated with an increased likelihood of chronic villitis of unknown etiology (VUE), and VUE placentas demonstrated a higher prevalence of other abnormal placental pathologies and small for gestational age.
gest_age: Deliveries ≥ 20 weeks; Small for gestational age mentioned as an outcome
